fit: eighth fit, M1 tube by tube
why: P. Broqvist, 2026-10-23: go step by step, M1 first, one experiment at a time. The fit of every tube at once is the seventh fit (05_fit7), which this run does not repeat

model: M1 alone (one Marcus barrier per family, computed energies, network R1-R9 + N10-N15, EC/DEC 1:1 linear, water of 'TMSPa alone' declared at 65.6 mM, 2 % tube heated 8 h per step): everything as in the seventh fit but the order in which the tubes are used
scenarios: every unknown age 10 min, 1 h or 8 h (the user's choice of the ages to try)

steps, each at every reading: S1 'TMSOH, glovebox' (condensation and solvent attack; no phosphate, known history); S2 'TMSPa + TMSOH (A)' (transfer; hydrolysis held off, no water was added); S3 'TMSPa alone' (hydrolysis; its two spectra 243 h apart are the only time the data record); S2b tube A again with the hydrolysis of S3 (does transfer move?); S4 '0.5 % H2O' (hydrolysis alone again: does it agree with S3?); S5 '2 % H2O' (nothing free: a test of the computed energies). A barrier no earlier step set is held off, at the top of its box
after every step every tube is scored with that step's barriers: the tubes not used yet are predictions, the validation of the steps before

step_variants: the 2 % tube also as P. Broqvist reads it (BatteryAsTank, tmspa_reaction_network_model): its first spectrum after 8 h at room temperature and 8 h at 30 °C (plus 1 h of acquisition), so after the 30 °C step and not before every heating; the file timestamps put that spectrum 16 h before the 30 °C acquisition, the file name ('22oC after 3oC') reads as after it
effort: one or two free barriers per step, so a light search (256 screen points, 8 starts); profiles of the free barriers of every step
